functionalArchitectureSummary.washPath: Front-load horizontal drum; inlet valves, water level frequency sensor, drain/circulation pump, BLDC wash motor (6.0 Ω), door lock/switch, wash heater + thermistor, overflow/leak/unbalance/MEMS paths — §4-4 corrective actions.
functionalArchitectureSummary.dryPath: Heat-pump ventless: BLDC compressor (3CA family), EVA IN/OUT + discharge + compressor-top + dry-heater thermistors (§4-5), supplemental dry heater element (35.6–39.4 Ω), dehumidifying-kit magnet interlock (NC), foam-in-dehumidification (ULC), auto-open door (DC5). No external exhaust vent as primary moisture rejection.
functionalArchitectureSummary.integration: Single Smart Install controller spans wash steps 1–8 and dry steps 9–10 (dry heater + fan, door). Shared main PBA + inverter/LCD comm (AC, AC3–AC6). One drum, one motor for wash spin and dry tumble.
functionalArchitectureSummary.topLoadRelevance: Not top-load — vertical-axis TL washer contract not implicated.
